hypothesis: The P0-versus-P2 non-inferiority observed at Gaussian sigma=.04 has a shift-severity frontier: as the same Gaussian perturbation direction is scaled upward, explicit P2 teacher-residual correction may become functionally necessary under the locked margins.

architecture.base_recursive_hierarchy: same C61R-C65R construction: four TinyRes(64,8) locals -> two retrained pairs -> two TinyRes(64,16) compressors -> Chain

shift_severity_grid.construction: for each model seed, draw one calibration epsilon~N(0,I) and one validation epsilon~N(0,I), then evaluate clip(X + sigma*epsilon,0,1) at every locked sigma
shift_severity_grid.pairing: P0/P2 and all sigma values within a model seed share the same underlying standardized calibration/validation perturbation directions
shift_severity_grid.reason: common-random-number dose response reduces irrelevant between-sigma noise; this is an exploratory severity protocol, not a claim that independent shifts are identical

calibration.subset_rule: same protocol-fixed clean-training subset rule as C61R-C65R

conditions.P0: at each sigma, frozen base recursive hierarchy compiled directly on the shifted calibration inputs; no teacher residual correction and no top-boundary adaptation
conditions.P2: at each sigma, first 2 columns of canonical QR of the shifted-calibration teacher residual transpose, then top-boundary adaptation to frozen_base_output + P2 residual projection

adaptation_and_compilation.p2_top_adaptation_seed_rule: model_seed + 665000, intentionally shared across sigma within a model seed
adaptation_and_compilation.compiled_final_init_seed_rule: model_seed + 666000, intentionally shared across sigma within a model seed and P0/P2
adaptation_and_compilation.compiled_final_fit_seed_rule: model_seed + 667000, intentionally shared across sigma within a model seed and P0/P2
adaptation_and_compilation.pairing_reason: hold initialization and minibatch-index randomness fixed across severity so sigma is the intended varying factor

per_sigma: teacher shifted-validation accuracy and drop from clean teacher accuracy
frozen hierarchy activation NMSE versus teacher before final compilation
P2 Euclidean residual capture on shifted validation
P2 logit-L2 retained ratio on shifted validation
P2 local categorical-Fisher retained ratio on shifted validation
mechanism_diagnostics.role: mechanism-generating only; not multiplicity-corrected confirmatory evidence

eligibility.eligible_seed_if: runner completes the entire locked sigma grid, exact recursive parameter-budget invariant holds, and all required P0/P2/teacher/mechanism metrics at every sigma are finite with positive P0/P2 NMSE

validation_noninferiority.statistic: paired P0 minus P2 shifted-validation accuracy
validation_noninferiority.pass: paired percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > -2.0 percentage points

nmse_ratio.statistic: geometric mean of paired P0/P2 NMSE ratios

rules: if sigma=.04 does not jointly pass: STOP_REPLICATION_INSTABILITY_AT_SIGMA_0.04
else if all higher sigmas jointly pass: NO_P0_FAILURE_THROUGH_SIGMA_0.20
else if joint-pass pattern is monotone (once false, never true again): select the smallest failing sigma and return SELECT_SIGMA_<value>_FOR_C67R

bootstrap.method: paired model-seed percentile 95%; one common bootstrap index matrix reused across sigma to preserve dose-response pairing

analysis_boundary.scope: exact C66R Residual-MLP common-random-number Gaussian severity grid only
not_supported_even_if_frontier_found: the selected grid sigma is the exact continuous critical sigma
P0 fails universally above that sigma
P2 is universally necessary above that sigma
task-weighted diagnostics causally determine the frontier
